# Known indicators of a poisoned repository: strings that loaders planted in other projects'
# commits contain (addresses they read their next stage from, the hosts and calls they use,
# names they leave behind). tools/security/scan_suspicious.py flags any of them, in any case.
#
# One per line, as the hex of its lowercase UTF-8 text, so that this file and its history never
# match a search for the indicators themselves. Readable copy:
#     python tools/security/scan_suspicious.py --show-indicators
# Add one: python -c "print('<text>'.lower().encode().hex())"
